200.title: Poland’s anti-Ukrainian turn spills into violence
200.summary: News Politics Poland’s anti-Ukrainian turn spills into violence The number of crimes against Ukrainians in Poland is rising as right-wing Polish politicians ramp-up anti-Ukraine rhetoric.
200.body: News Politics Poland’s anti-Ukrainian turn spills into violence The number of crimes against Ukrainians in Poland is rising as right-wing Polish politicians ramp-up anti-Ukraine rhetoric. This summer, Polish President Karol Nawrocki stripped his Ukrainian counterpart, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, of Poland’s highest honor, the Order of the White Eagle, in reaction to Zelenskyy’s decision to name a military unit after the World War II-era Ukrainian Insurgent Army, or UPA. “Now I’m afraid no one would help me and that I would be accused of violating some law and simply deported, even though I’ve already built my life in Poland.” The government’s policy is to deport Ukrainians even for minor offenses — one Ukrainian 18-year-old was kicked out of Poland for jumping a barrier at a concert. 200.title: SNT Firms Target NATO Defense Market at Poland's MSPO 2026
200.summary: BUSAN — SNT Dynamics and SNT Motiv are jointly exhibiting at MSPO 2026, an international defense industry exhibition held in Kielce, Poland, from the 8th to the 11th, as the two companies push into the defense market of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
200.body: BUSAN — SNT Dynamics and SNT Motiv are jointly exhibiting at MSPO 2026, an international defense industry exhibition held in Kielce, Poland, from the 8th to the 11th, as the two companies push into the defense market of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO). MSPO ranks among Europe's three largest defense exhibitions alongside Britain's DSEI and France's Eurosatory. The two companies plan to strengthen joint technical marketing at the event and expand exports of Korean defense products to NATO countries. An SNT official said the companies will continue to strengthen joint technical marketing to enter the NATO defense market, adding that they will expand exports of integrated defense solution packages spanning maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) and integrated product support (IPS), going beyond simply supplying weapons.

400.title: Massive offshore wind farms could shift rainfall across Europe’s coasts
400.summary: When built in large clusters, they can also slow the wind, stir the lower atmosphere and change where moisture falls as rain.A modeling study from Hereon’s Institute of Coastal Systems, Analysis and Modeling examined how major offshore wind expansion could affect weather over the North Sea and Baltic Sea. In the model, large offshore wind expansion increased precipitation over the wind farm areas themselves.
400.body: When built in large clusters, they can also slow the wind, stir the lower atmosphere and change where moisture falls as rain.A modeling study from Hereon’s Institute of Coastal Systems, Analysis and Modeling examined how major offshore wind expansion could affect weather over the North Sea and Baltic Sea. In the model, large offshore wind expansion increased precipitation over the wind farm areas themselves. That process can lead to cloud formation and precipitation over the wind farms.But air does not carry unlimited moisture.If more moisture falls as rain over offshore wind farm areas, less remains available for regions downwind. Their placement can affect wind, turbulence and moisture transport across national borders.Clean energy with regional trade-offsThe results do not challenge the role of offshore wind in climate protection.
